card.name: Digit 1 in Bible verse numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 inside a verse number in a Bible citation, mostly the tens digit of a range such as 1:12-18 or 1:13-14. It also fires weakly on a 1 inside a zip code.

modes.label: Verse range digit
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a two-digit verse number, usually after a hyphen in a scripture reference.

modes.label: Zip code digit
modes.description: The digit 1 inside a five-digit US zip code in a manufacturer address.

card.writes: It promotes digit-like or short continuation pieces and suppresses 'st'-type pieces, so it helps the model continue a number.
card.plain: It marks the digit 1 within a Bible verse number, such as the 1 in 1:13-14.
